parameters: CE_001 New Game Init. Runs once; S0001 is the replay guard.
Already initialised (load / re-entry): never re-roll anything.
CE_002 Select Culprit. THE culprit is chosen exactly once per New Game.
Double guard: S0002 locked AND Culprit_ID still 0. After a load S0002 is
ON, so this returns without touching V6.
CE_003 Default states. Migration-guarded: only runs below current schema.
New game only: gameplay values are never reset on an ordinary load.
All NPC location variables start off-map (0).
CE_004 Day Start. Called on day transition only, never on load (CE_024 does that).
Invalid day: refuse rather than start a broken day.
CE_005 Day End. Guarded by the Day_N_Complete switch so an interrupted
day-end cannot advance the calendar twice.
Window passed with the mandatory scene unresolved: run its fallback.
CE_006 Advance Time. Input: V21 Action_Minutes. Always clears V21.
Absolute minutes, then derive the block by an ascending cascade.
Past 23:00 the day is over: clamp and request day end.
Block changed => refresh the systems that read the clock.
CE_007 Spend AP. Inputs: V22 AP cost, V21 minutes.
Atomic: AP, clock and inputs settle with no yielding command between them,
so an interrupted call cannot spend AP without advancing time.
Every path clears V21 and V22.
CE_008 Check AP. Only ever OFFERS the day end; it never advances the day itself.
Instance switches are cleared FIRST, then at most one is turned back on,
so the singleton invariant holds even if this is re-entered.
Populated by tools/build/30-npc-schedules.js once schedules are generated.
CE_010 Refresh audio. Resolves the semantic slot for (map, time block)
V27/V28 hold the profile currently playing. A track is only (re)started
when the resolved profile actually differs, so walking back into a room
does not restart the music from the top.
This map has no standing ambience: stop the old one rather than leave it running.
CE_011 Weather + lighting. Native Tint Screen / Set Weather Effect only.
Interiors carry no weather; only the exterior estate does.
CE_012 Add Evidence. Input V23 = clue item id. 49 clues.
Generated by tools/build/41-evidence.js -- do not hand-edit.
Each clue's switch guards it: a second discovery grants nothing and costs
nothing, which is what stops a reloaded scene from duplicating evidence.
Ночная запись часовни и синий воск
CE_013 Present evidence. Costs 0 AP and 0 minutes by design (RULE_MANDATORY).
CE_014 Update relationship. Inputs V24 delta, V25 npc. Clamped to -100..100.
CE_015 Recalculate derived states. Cheap no-op unless the dirty flag is set.
CE_016 Mandatory event check. Never leaves S0008 pending on exit: whichever
branch runs, the flag and V29 are cleared before returning.
CE_017 Repeat dialogue select. Falls through to CE_018 when nothing is left.
CE_018 Exhausted dialogue. No AP, no minutes, no relationship change.
Мы ведь уже говорили об этом.
CE_019_Evaluate_Official. Always yields V8 in 0..3 -- a weak plan scores low, it never blocks.
CE_020_Evaluate_Ambush. Always yields V8 in 0..3 -- a weak plan scores low, it never blocks.
CE_021_Evaluate_Lockdown. Always yields V8 in 0..3 -- a weak plan scores low, it never blocks.
CE_022 Final resolver. Total by construction: strategy 0 (the player never
chose one) resolves to a per-culprit NONE leaf, so every Culprit x Strategy
x Quality combination lands on a result. V30 > 0 is asserted before ending.
<<GENERATED_ENDING_MATRIX>> 6 culprits x 4 strategy states x 4 qualities
Fallback leaf: no generated branch matched, still produce a result.
CE_023 Autosave checkpoint. Uses the real MZ API (SceneManager requestAutosave
-> slot 0), not an invented 'Autosave' command. A failed autosave must not
damage game state, so nothing persistent is mutated after the Script call.
// Autosave through the engine's own path; guarded so a missing scene
// or a disabled save slot degrades to a no-op instead of an exception.
CE_024 Map enter. The load/transfer entry point: restores ambience and
schedules WITHOUT touching day, clock or AP (that is CE_004's job only).
Cinematic or unknown map: leave schedules and audio to the scene.
CE_025 Debug report. Deployment builds ship with S0900 OFF.
